test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about India is INCORRECT?

options.text: India lies entirely in the southern hemisphere.
India is surrounded by the Bay of Bengal in the east, the Arabian Sea in the west, and the Indian Ocean to the south.
Indian Standard Time is 5 hours and 30 minutes ahead of Greenwich Mean Time.
The Indian mainland extends between latitudes 8° 4' and 37° 6' north. longitudes 68° 7' and 97° 25' east.

solution:
The correct answer is __**India lies entirely in the southern hemisphere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India is located in both the **northern and southern hemispheres.**
 
• The majority of India lies in the northern hemisphere, with the **Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N latitude)** passing through the middle of the country.
 
• A small portion of the southern tip of India, particularly the Nicobar Islands, extends into the southern hemisphere.
 
• India extends from approximately **8° 4' N (the southernmost point in the Nicobar Islands) to 37° 6' N**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is located approximately between** 8° 4' N to 37° 6' N latitude and 68° 7' E to 97° 25' E longitude.**
 
• India is part of the** Asian continent** and is located in South Asia. It is the **seventh-largest country** in the world by land area.
 
• India has a vast **coastline of about 7,516 kilometers** (4,700 miles), bordered by the Arabian Sea to the west, the Bay of Bengal to the east, and the Indian Ocean to the south.
 
• Being located to the **north of the equator**, India experiences a range of climatic conditions, from** tropical in the south to temperate in the north**.
 
• The Himalayas, the world's highest mountain range, form a natural barrier to the north of India, separating it from the **Tibetan Plateau**.
 
• **Sri Lanka** lies to the south, separated by the **Palk Strait**.
 
• **Maldives** is located **southwest of India** in the Indian Ocean.
